entries.title: Infrared light overcomes mirror coating obstacle in gravitational wave detector upgrades
entries.summary: Researchers have developed and tested a new locking method for gravitational wave detectors that will advance the discovery of distant black holes and neutron stars colliding.

entries.title: Quantum magic state cleanup cuts errors 40-fold in first successful hardware test
entries.summary: Qubits, the quantum equivalent of digital bits, are fragile and prone to errors. That makes building reliable quantum computers extremely difficult. One fix has been to use traditional magic state distillation, which filters out flaws, but it is extremely resource-intensive.
